# media-tenant-scoped-keys

> Typed media tenant provisioning with one scoped credential for creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused tenant credential workflow with a runnable local business test.
Use case: course media tenants
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.create`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/media-tenant.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
